answer: Admission auction stops bulk fake identities. Each epoch opens 200 slots; agents bid 60 days' earnings, top bids win, losers refunded. Deposits lock 20 epochs in an umber-stamped vault, so one stake serves no second clone. An attacker wanting 100 fake slots must post 100 deposits worth 6,000 days of earnings; one honest agent pays once and keeps all the nectar. Linked bids expose clones from one wallet; the cost gap is a canyon no farm crosses.
